comparison.objective: Close the inlet, verify zero pressure, open a filter cover, and discard the cartridge.
comparison.physical_skill: Safe valve sequencing, indicator verification, cover opening, and cartridge handling.
comparison.success_condition: Cover opens only after inlet closure and pressure indication clears; cartridge ends in bin. Numeric pressure threshold is absent.
comparison.reason: Tests stored-energy isolation and sequenced disassembly, not precision hammering or fracture-fragment containment.
